Ghaziabad Student Dies by Suicide After Alleged Pressure

A 7th-grade student in Ghaziabad died by suicide by jumping from the 10th floor of a building. The student reportedly left a note stating she was weak in math. One report alleges a teacher is responsible for the student's death.
